full_page.content:
1948, March 27
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
March 27, 1948
Mr. Joseph J. O'Donnell 1120 Lakeshore Drive Chicago, Illinois
St. Felix Friary Route 8 Huntington, Indiana
Easter Holy Saturday 10:15.am.
Bles'd be the Crucified Risen!
(March 27) God bless you Joseph J. O'Donnell - with Winnie and all your dear ones.
As surmised when phoning last Sunday, I was set for your high Mass on Wednesday but that morning Fr. Guargian whispered to me a little change in schedule in your favor. "We'll offer the solemn Mass for the O'Donnell intentions next Sunday. Write them to that effect ... " I wanted to do so that day - and every day since and now its almost time for the daily "pick up" So I'll add our simple Easter greeting and felicitations with a hearty God's blessing to all repeated for all the Easter Season.
.Sincerely Yours in Christ, Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
Praised be Jesus Christ!
